overview.description: The Corgi Emerging Markets Equities 15% Structured Buffer ETF - September Series (EMSE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to provide investors with returns that generally match the price return (excluding dividends) of the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF, up to the upside cap of 29.20% while providing a buffer against the first 15% of iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF losses, over the period from September 1, 2026 to August 31, 2027. EMSE was launched on Sep 14, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
